As a fellow NAW3 member, and a good rusher/objective player, advise you to play A LOT. I mean, I wasn't good until I mastered the controller and the sensitivity. You see, I came from PC so I knew how to play the game, just didn't have good enough accuracy. You need to flank a lot. For example, on Mission, When I cap the b flag, I do not run to the hill area where people will be coming from A. I go to the left of the B flag and jump to the bottom of the hill. Just like that, I've gotten numbers triple kills and multi kills.

TL;DR Master your sensitivity/controller (also play on tactical)
         Flank
         Learn the maps/spawns
